description: This file defines an in-memory, thread-safe product repository implementing basic CRUD operations, mainly for demo and testing purposes. It uses a concurrent dictionary to store product instances and provides asynchronous methods to interact with the data.

classes.name: InMemoryProductRepository
classes.description: A thread-safe, in-memory repository for products supporting asynchronous CRUD operations.

methods.name: InMemoryProductRepository
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository with seed data for quick testing.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all products ordered by name.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a product by its unique identifier.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new product, assigning a new GUID if necessary, and stores it.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing product by its ID; returns null if the product does not exist.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a product by its ID; returns true if successful.
